description: The importing country's tariff lines for a commodity code or HS prefix: description, MFN duty, tariff preferences with their agreements and quotas, suspensions, extra duties (anti-dumping and others, grouped by exporter additional code), import VAT, excise and other charges, each in the tariff's own wording, as of the tariff's version date. Tariffs: gb (the UK), eu or an EU member state (de, fr, it, es, nl…; its import VAT applies), us (the United States) or in (India). With origin, only the measures for that origin and the best preferential rate. Paginated: pass nextCursor as cursor for more lines. Not a customs ruling.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, with the same destination, hs_code and origin.

destination.description: Importing country (required, or give importer): gb (the UK), eu or an EU member state (de, fr, it, es, nl…; its import VAT applies), us (the United States) or in (India). Names work too ("United Kingdom", "Germany").

hs_code.description: Commodity code: an HS prefix (2, 4, 6 or 8 digits) or the full 10-digit code, e.g. "0901" or "8471.30"; dots and spaces are ignored.

origin.description: Country of origin (ISO code or name): keeps only the measures that apply to it and adds the best preferential rate.
